Dorenne.title: Dorenne
Dorenne.extract: Dorenne is the largest city and main commercial port of Velmora, located at the mouth of the Tembaya River delta.

Velmora.title: Velmora
Velmora.extract: Velmora is a country in Southeast Asia; its capital and seat of government is Rivelle.
